description: Network slicing divides a shared network platform into logically separated, end-to-end optimized networks. Each slice can be tailored to specific requirements for latency, reliability, bandwidth, security, and resource allocation.

featured.title: Smart Dynamic Pricing and Cooperative Resource Management for Mobility-Aware and Multi-Tier Slice-Enabled 5G and Beyond Networks
featured.authors: A. Nouruzi, N. Mokari, P. Azmi, E. A. Jorswieck, und M. Erol-Kantarci
featured.venue: IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management
featured.summary: Investigates “Smart Dynamic Pricing and Cooperative Resource Management for Mobility-Aware and Multi-Tier Slice-Enabled 5G and Beyond Networks”. Focus: the core mechanism, system behavior and engineering implications in Network Slicing, giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.
